ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Attack, CardRarity.Basic, TargetType.AnyEnemy)` (StrikeIronclad.cs:24-27) == cost 1 / ATTACK / BASIC / ANY_ENEMY. The C# class is StrikeIronclad and the sim registers it as id `strike`; the roster resolves that through audit/tools/name_overrides.json, correctly, and the source's own comment confirms the five character Strikes differ only in "portrait, attack vfx, and color" -- so an Ironclad-only sim is right to port just this one.

CanonicalTags.rationale: `new HashSet<CardTag> { CardTag.Strike }` (StrikeIronclad.cs:17) == the tag set. Load-bearing for card/perfected_strike's count and for the Sharpened enchantment.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new DamageVar(6m, ValueProp.Move)` (StrikeIronclad.cs:19) == `_damage = 6`, powered on both sides.

OnPlay.rationale: `DamageCmd.Attack(6).FromCard(this).Targeting(cardPlay.Target)` (StrikeIronclad.cs:32-34) == the sim's single `DamageCmd.deal(..., dealer=ctx.player, card=self)`. No follow-up effect and no guard on either side -- the simplest card in the pool, and the one every other Attack's shape is measured against.
